svg.title: Butuan: keep the source and claim connected
svg.desc: Butuan is in northeastern Mindanao. Original wood and joins are material evidence; a classroom diagram explains selected features. Neither identifies all passengers or voyages.

g.text: Butuan: keep the source and claim connected
EVIDENCE: recorded boat remains, wood and joins
SUPPORTED QUESTION: how were parts constructed?
LIMIT: not a record of every passenger or voyage
A modern teaching card is not an original ancient boat part.
